expectations.text: The module lives in server/src/modules/tags/ and its files are named by role (routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts, optionally helpers.ts and constants.ts), not by feature or pattern (no tags.controller.ts, tags.service.ts, dto/ or models/)
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: modules/tags/ has constants, helpers, repository, routes, service.

expectations.text: TagService takes the whole Container in its constructor and builds its own repository from container.db
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: TagService constructor(container: Container) and repository from container.db.

expectations.text: routes.ts imports only its service, shared contracts, zod and fastify: no drizzle-orm, db client or schema, and each handler makes one service call
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: routes.ts imports fastify, zod, shared contracts, Container type, TagService only.

expectations.text: The Tag contract is a Zod schema under server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/ and NOTES.md says it must also be copied by hand to client/src/vendor/shared
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: Contract in server/src/vendor/shared/contracts/tags.ts; NOTES.md mentions manual copy to client/src/vendor/shared.

notes: 4th expectation (repository returns shared Tag, not Drizzle row) excluded for both configs: the skill's own layer-map allows a row type at the repository-service seam when the service maps it.
